Class SshIoTrace

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.SshIoTrace
class SshIoTrace extends Object
The SshIoTrace class writes an info line for every connect and disconnect on the Casserole SSH listener. One line starts with ssh-io. The password never appears. iface-mac is the hardware address of the server interface that owns the local socket. peer-mac stays absent. The SSH session does not carry the peer hardware address. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshIoTrace FINESSE:f-147

    • attach

      static void attach(org.apache.sshd.server.SshServer server)

      Parameters:
      server - The server is the listener about to start.

    • authReject

      static void authReject(org.apache.sshd.common.session.Session session, String username)
      The method writes an auth-reject line when an authenticator returns false. The password is not a parameter of this method.
      Parameters:
      session - The session is the session that offered the name.
      username - The username is the offered name.

    • info

      private static void info(String event, org.apache.sshd.common.session.Session session, org.apache.sshd.common.channel.Channel channel, String extra)
      The method writes one info line with no username override.
      Parameters:
      event - The event is the event name.
      session - The session is the SSH session, or null.
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel, or null.
      extra - The extra text is appended when it is not empty.

    • info

      private static void info(String event, org.apache.sshd.common.session.Session session, org.apache.sshd.common.channel.Channel channel, String extra, String userOverride)
      The method writes one ssh-io info line. A failure while building the line logs trace-fault and the exception class name. The password is not written.
      Parameters:
      event - The event is the event name.
      session - The session is the SSH session, or null.
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel, or null when the line has no channel fields.
      extra - The extra text is appended when it is not empty.
      userOverride - The override replaces the session user when it is not null.

    • appendCommon

      private static void appendCommon(StringBuilder line, org.apache.sshd.common.session.Session session, String userOverride)
      The method appends the session id, the user, both endpoints, both versions, and both hardware-address fields. A read failure for an address or a version leaves that field absent. peer-mac is always absent.
      Parameters:
      line - The line is the buffer being built.
      session - The session is the SSH session, or null.
      userOverride - The override replaces the session user when it is not null.

    • appendChannel

      private static void appendChannel(StringBuilder line, org.apache.sshd.common.channel.Channel channel)
      The method appends the channel id, the recipient, the channel type, and the channel class. A TCP/IP server channel uses its TCP/IP type name. Any other channel uses absent for the type. A missing id becomes -1.
      Parameters:
      line - The line is the buffer being built.
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel.

    • appendEndpoint

      private static void appendEndpoint(StringBuilder line, String prefix, SocketAddress address)
      The method appends the IP and the port for one endpoint. An internet address uses the host address and the port. A null address, or an address that is not an internet address, uses absent for a missing part.
      Parameters:
      line - The line is the buffer being built.
      prefix - The prefix is remote or local.
      address - The address is the socket address, or null.

    • sessionId

      private static String sessionId(org.apache.sshd.common.session.Session session)
      The method returns the input-output session id. A null session, a missing input-output session, or a read failure returns absent.
      Parameters:
      session - The session is the SSH session, or null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the id text, or absent.

    • userOf

      private static String userOf(org.apache.sshd.common.session.Session session)
      The method returns the session user name as a log token. A null session or a read failure returns absent.
      Parameters:
      session - The session is the SSH session, or null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the user token, or absent.

      The method returns the milliseconds since the stored open time. A missing time, a null store, or a read failure returns absent. A negative delta becomes 0.

      The method returns the hardware address of the interface that owns the local address. A non-internet address, a wildcard address, a missing interface, an empty hardware address, or a socket failure returns absent.

    • findInterface

      private static NetworkInterface findInterface(InetAddress address) throws SocketException
      The method searches every network interface for the given address. A missing interface list returns null. No match returns null.

      address - The address is the local internet address.

    • formatMac

      private static String formatMac(byte[] hardware)
      The method formats a hardware address as lowercase hex bytes separated by colons. A byte below 16 gets a leading zero.
      Parameters:
      hardware - The bytes are the hardware address.
      Returns:
      The return value is the formatted address.

    • token

      private static String token(String raw)
      The method turns raw text into one log token. A null or blank value returns absent. The token is cut at 160 characters. A space, an equals sign, or delete becomes an underscore.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text is the value to place in a log field.
      Returns:
      The return value is the token.
